channel.name: legs
channel.purpose: Leg and ankle: design, drop test, gait gantry

context: Channel for Leg (left, hip to foot).
Ongoing: Leg DVT build: parts readiness and what to do about late test hardware. This week: Rev C links in, one fails inspection on a bore; Carlos builds with the good three.
Ongoing: Gait policy trained in sim overshoots on hardware; friction and backlash modelling
Ongoing: Integrated DVT plan across actuators and legs and which dates are real
Ongoing: Leg drop gantry shared by leg drop, torso static load and ankle impact. This week: Carlos trains a second tech; Wednesday added from November.
